title: Chapter 82: Breaking Out Of The Siege
content:
Chapter 82: Breaking Out Of The Siege

"Eat something, drink something, move around, and get ready to fight!"

The masked man leader picked up a supply bag dropped by the transport crew and shouted.

His voice was not loud and hoarse, but it could cover all the human wanderers. His words were clear, generous and powerful.

"Yes! Chief!"

The originally silent human wanderers were like beasts that had just woken up from sleep, and their ferocious aura suddenly burst out.

No amount of momentum is effective against the Zerg.

There were drinking water and high-calorie food in the supply bags of the accompanying people in the transportation team. Under the leadership of the masked leader, the human wanderers drank some drinking water first, then picked up the dry food and chewed it carefully, not in a hurry. .

All the human wanderers are like this, they are more disciplined and follow orders than a well-trained army.

After just a few simple bites, the human wanderers carried their supply bags on their backs, stretched their bodies, and then went to pick up weapons and equipment on the ground.

The accompanying personnel of the transport team are all armed personnel and can handle low-intensity battles.

They are of various races, come in different shapes and sizes, and are equipped with different weapons and equipment.

The human wanderers rummaged through and picked up some useful items.

“Don’t take too many things, keep them light!”

The masked man leader stood on an iron cage that was not falling apart, observed the surrounding situation, and reminded.

The one-star Hydralisk where Wu Qing's consciousness was located ran over. Needless to say, the two sides automatically became allies.

"You form your own formation and follow us to fight out!"

"You are not allowed to participate in the war unless necessary!"

On the battlefield, time was running out, so Wu Qing didn't say much.

"good!"

The masked man leader solemnly agreed, and in a few words he organized the two thousand human wanderers.

At this time, the Zerg army had destroyed the entire transport team. With the two armies converging and a steady stream of troops being replenished, the Zerg army's strength had returned to nearly 20,000.

To the west of the Zerg army, the enemies coming from the evil god's army camp were overwhelming and black, and they were connected together with no end in sight.

There are also several large cavalry teams that are making quick detours, trying to outflank the Zerg army's retreat.

In other directions, an encirclement has formed. The evil god's army formed a square formation with about five thousand troops, occupying favorable terrain, watching each other, and stationed at various passes.

This is the territory of the evil god's camp. The evil god's army knows the terrain here very well, and they can arrange their troops very calmly and quickly.

Such an encirclement by the evil god's army would make it impossible for even the most elite troops of the Tengu clan to escape.

But the Zerg are not the Tengu clan. The Zerg are not afraid of anything, and they dare to face any kind of difficulties.

The Zerg had three thousand Hydralisks and nearly 17,000 Puppies on the battlefield. The Zerg troops that came from the Zerg territory began to gather on the outside of the encirclement when the Evil God's army formed an encirclement.

After completing their mission, nearly 20,000 Zerg troops led 2,000 human wanderers to break out.

The target chosen by the Zerg to break through is still their favorite lizard man phalanx. Even if five thousand lizard men have a geographical advantage, they cannot stop a charge from the Zerg.

The Zerg never choose terrain when fighting. Their body structure allows them to perform normally in complex terrain environments.

But this time the Lizardmen are not fighting alone, they have strong backing to support them.

As soon as the Zerg army moved, the cavalry troops following the Zerg gave up their detours, accelerated and rushed forward, closely following the Zerg's footsteps.

The entire encirclement of the evil god's army quickly moved towards the lizard man phalanx, and the reserve troops outside the encirclement immediately moved towards the lizard man phalanx to provide support.

These actions of the Evil God Army were all seen by Wu Qing. He remained unmoved. By mobilizing the forces of the Evil God Army on such a large scale, his goal was initially achieved.

As for the Zerg army, the worst result is that they all die in battle. The price paid by the evil god army is enough for the Zerg to create several more Zerg troops of this size.

This kind of transaction is not a loss!

With the speed of the Zerg troops, a Zerg army of this size will reappear soon, and can still catch up with the next battle.

Now there are two thousand more human wanderers. If they can rush out, Wu Qing will definitely save them. If they can't rush out, everyone can only fight and die together.

The Zerg can guarantee that this time they will no longer have to be prisoners.

Both warring parties are species that have distorted the concept of death and do not know what fear is. The terrifying insect tide rushed towards the standing lizard man phalanx.

This time the charge was led by three thousand Hydralisks. As soon as the lizardman phalanx entered the range of the Hydralisks, the terrifying Zerg spikes flew over.

The fragile lizardmen were targets for slaughter. They fell one by one. Before the Zerg army could rush in front of them, all the more than 5,000 lizardmen turned into light and disappeared.

Two thousand human wanderers were caught in the middle by the Zerg. They could not see the battle ahead. It only felt like they rushed through an enemy's defense line without stopping for a moment.

Their physical fitness is very good. Just by simply eating, their burst of speed can barely keep up with the charging Zerg troops.

The lizardman phalanx could not stop the Zerg's charge. This was expected by the evil god's army. Behind the lizardman phalanx were five thousand bugbears, five thousand long-armed ogres, and several native races that had converted to the evil god. A powerful racial unit with a strength of 30,000.

The Zerg was trapped in the encirclement of the evil god's army. No matter what they chose, they could not avoid a tough battle. They simply went straight and fought all the way.

The Zerg army rushed through the Lizardmen's defense line and was met with an overwhelming attack of spears!

The long-armed ogres threw a large number of spears with the converted native races!

The puppies beside the hydralisk rushed up and used their blade arms and bodies to block the attack of the spears for the hydralisk. The hydralisk ignored it and charged while spraying spikes to launch a counterattack.

Faced with a large number of spear attacks, especially the powerful spears thrown by the long-armed ogres, the Zerg puppies suffered some casualties.

Those puppies who were severely injured and inconvenient to move were freed by their companions with a knife and returned to the arms of the master.

The human wanderers who followed the Zerg troops to charge in a safe position saw all this.

At this time, the left and right phalanxes that were watching each other with the lizardmen phalanx were quickly encircling, and other phalanxes at a farther distance were also moving in this direction.

Behind the Zerg army, several large cavalry teams were approaching quickly, and the Zerg army was in a very bad situation!

Far away, countless evil god armies continued to join the siege.

Perhaps the top brass of the evil god army camp had realized that their important sacrifice was lost!
